THE SYSTEM (Grow with Alex method, applied to Golden Horseshoe Watch)

Three colours, each with a job:
• Background: charcoal #17140F
• Primary text: off-white #F2ECE0
• Accent (sparingly): amber #D4A24C

Two fonts: Anton (display, headlines only) + DM Sans (body, captions, numbers).

One layout, never changes: eyebrow + headline top zone · handle bottom-left · arrow bottom-right · 80px margins on 1080×1350.

ART RULE
Raccoon detective + horseshoe glass appears on explainer / findings / checklist covers only. Never on real-case or story slides (see the Story artboard: text, one amber rule, no mark).

Higgsfield renders the full-bleed art at 4:5 and this type layer sits on top. Keep the photo inside the three colours: charcoal shadow, amber lamp glow, off-white type. No stray blues or greens.

BEFORE ANY SLIDE SHIPS
• Shrink test: still legible at feed-thumbnail size?
• Swap test: could this belong to any other account? If yes, it's not done.
• Sourcing: every stat and story is Ontario / GTA real. Legal claims verified against the RTA or Tribunals Ontario before posting.

COPY STATUS
Cover + item 01 carry draft copy for "5 Things Your Landlord CAN Legally Do" (posting-order slot 3 in the idea bank). Draft only: run the sourcing pass before posting.

Bracketed text on the Story slide is a placeholder by design. Fill it only with a verified case.
